title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region pinning in audit logs and residency policies
author: Aditi Rao
description: Motivation: Harden RBAC v2 by ensuring KMS key region pinning is surfaced to audit logs and enforced by data-residency policy checks. Customers operating in regulated regions need guarantees that keys and related metadata are pinned to allowed regions and that audit trails record pinning intent and enforcement events. This PR implements: 1) audit log enrichment for KMS operations to include region_pin metadata, 2) residency policy evaluation hooks in RBAC v2 that block/flag operations when KMS region constraints are violated (configurable enforcement level: audit-only, enforce), and 3) migration helpers and tests for existing KMS bindings. Changes are backward-compatible by default (new policy flag defaults to "audit-only"). Checklist: - [x] Add KMS region pin metadata to audit events - [x] Add residency policy evaluator and PD for RBAC v2 - [x] Expose enforcement mode via admin config and Console UI flags (console changes in a follow-up PR) - [x] Add unit + integration tests for policy evaluation and audit enrichment - [x] Smoke tested on staging with sample keys and residency configs Rollout plan: stage (staging cluster) -> canary on dedicated customers with residency requirements -> global rollout once telemetry shows zero false positives. See linked Linear tasks for rollout automation and console UX. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps enforcement configurable. When enforcement mode set to "enforce" RBAC checks will fail request if KMS key region does not match residency constraints. When in "audit-only" mode the check logs an AUDIT_RESIDENCY_PIN_VIOLATION event and attaches the violating region to the event payload. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged for customers not opting into residency enforcement. Migration: included helper script to backfill audit events for the last 30 days (best-effort) and a database migration to add the region_pin field to the audit_events table. CI: All unit/integration tests pass in build; e2e flakiness observed in unrelated streaming test and retriggered and resolved.
commits: feat(rbac): add residency policy evaluator and enforcement mode
feat(audit): enrich KMS audit events with region_pin metadata
db(migration): add region_pin column to audit_events (nullable)
test: add unit + integration tests for residency checks
chore: add migration helper to backfill audit events
review_comments: Jorge Martinez: Can you clarify behaviour when a key has no region metadata? Should we treat as unknown and audit-only by default?
Aditi Rao: We treat missing region as unknown and emit AUDIT_RESIDENCY_PIN_UNKNOWN in audit events. Enforcement mode will treat unknown as deny when admin sets enforcement to strict (documented).
Priya Singh: Please add a feature flag to gate the migration; rolling back a migration during incidents must be straightforward.
Aditi Rao: Added a feature flag (config/residency.yaml) and a reversible migration. Included rollback SQL in the PR.
Evan Zhao: Unit tests look good. Suggest adding an integration test that simulates cross-region fail and then switches enforcement to audit-only to confirm no user-visible failures.
Aditi Rao: Added integration test 'residency_policy_test.go' that covers both modes and verifies emitted audit event types.
ci_checks: e2e-tests: flaky (streaming test) - retriggered and passed
release_notes: Add audit-enrichment for KMS region pinning and residency policy hooks for RBAC v2. Introduces configurable enforcement (audit-only|enforce) and a DB migration to store region_pin on audit events. Default is audit-only; no customer-facing behavior change unless enforcement is enabled.
